definitions.ask: How should the Work Log stamp read?
definitions.why: Bob already writes date-times as YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM, which sorts and greps as text

choices.label: `*2026-11-01 14:32* — …`: matches BOB_NOW and gcal's synced stamp; narrowest rows
`*Sun 2026-11-01 14:32* — …`: adds the weekday for skimming; 4 chars wider per row
